objective: Engineering Team Activation V1: Make concurrent multi-objective operation a real operating path the owner can watch. Add a new read-only script crooks-assistant/scripts/engineering_team.py taking the same --store/--repo/--registry/--runtime-root/--workspace-root/--max-concurrent arguments as scripts/engineering_dispatcher.py (build the Dispatcher the same way, importing from app.orchestrator; do not modify engineering_dispatcher.py). It prints one line per objective (objective id, stage, current attempt id, builder kind, live builder pids, reviewer principal and mechanism when reviewing, blocker when blocked), then totals (building, reviewing, blocked, complete, other) and --max-concurrent with how many builder slots are free; --json prints the same as one JSON object. It must never tick, launch, write a record or change a file: it only reads Dispatcher.status() and the store. Test it in a new tests/test_engineering_team.py using the World helper from tests/test_engineering_dispatcher.py (import it the way tests/test_gpt_reviewer.py does).
